verdict.rationale: The firm's Intellectual Property page has a dedicated Trademark and Copyright section. It covers filing and prosecuting domestic and foreign trademark applications, including Madrid Protocol filings, for clients from start-ups to Fortune 500 companies, and trademark licensing is handled under Technology Transactions. That evidences registration as a documented sub-practice, but the rest of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: trademark clearance/search services, brand enforcement (oppositions, cease-and-desist, litigation), a dedicated trademark team or attorneys, and independent corroboration.
